transport.intro: Notifications and replies to requesters go out through this server. Emails carry the ticket number and a reply token, so an email reply lands in the same ticket.
transport.fallback: The installation settings from environment variables are in use. Save your own to send from your domain.
transport.none: Email sending is not set up: notifications appear only in the notification center.
transport.secretSet: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
transport.replyToHint: Usually the support mailbox from the Mailboxes tab. Empty sends replies to the from address.
transport.testToHint: Empty sends it to your address
transport.testOk: The server accepted the connection, a test email is queued

mailboxes.intro: An email to a mailbox creates a ticket, and a reply to a system email is added to its ticket. Senders are checked with SPF, DKIM and DMARC.
mailboxes.smtpHint: Your mail server forwards emails to the Easy ITSM inbound port. No polling needed.

policyHint.enforce: Rejects emails the sender domain asks to reject and quarantines doubtful ones.
policyHint.strict: Quarantines everything that fails DMARC, even when the domain does not ask.
policyHint.monitor: Accepts everything and records the check result. For the first days after connecting.

mailboxes.trustedAuthservHint: Server names from the Authentication-Results header, comma separated, for example mx.example.com. Empty makes Easy ITSM verify signatures itself.
mailboxes.deleteConfirm: Delete mailbox {{address}}? Emails to this address will no longer create tickets.

inbound.intro: Every email received by the mailboxes and what was done with it. Quarantined emails can be accepted by hand.
inbound.subject: Subject

outgoing.intro: The email queue. Failed attempts are retried after 1, 5, 30 minutes, 2 and 6 hours.
outgoing.subject: Subject
